title: Tanker report - Week 45
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index eased by eight points this week to WS1005, while the corresponding Baltic round-trip TCE edged up by $100 to $292,000/day. For the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent run, the index dropped by $2.21 million to $19.29 million, corresponding to $297,300/day on Baltic round trip. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index shed $1.70 million to finish at $9.25 million, with the Baltic round-trip TCE falling by $20,400 to $79,200/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange routes headed down this week. The TD3C route (270,000 mt Middle East Gulf/China) has fallen almost 47 points since last Friday to WS1220.63, producing a daily round-trip TCE of $1,303,616 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: The Suezmax market has started to rebalance, with rates falling sharply across all the Baltic Exchange routes. The rate for the 130,000 mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) fell by over 270 points (38%) to WS430, giving a daily round-trip TCE of about $224,500.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for the 80,000 mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) tumbled 212.5 points to WS350, giving a daily round-trip TCE of just below $242,600 basis Hound Point/Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for the 80,000 mt Cross-Mediterranean route (TD19) collapsed almost 373 points to WS300.
